title: Viyana Karayolu Trafiği Sözleşmesi (1968), madde 6: yetkili görevlilerin talimatları
note: Convention on Road Traffic, art. 6: officials directing traffic; arm raised, arms outstretched, precedence over signs, lights and markings. KKTC is not a party; used for the general international meaning only.

title: Viyana Yol İşaretleri ve Sinyalleri Sözleşmesi (1968), BM antlaşma kaydı
note: Convention on Road Signs and Signals: traffic light signals and road markings. KKTC is not a party; Türkiye and the Republic of Cyprus are.

title: The Highway Code (UK), Signals by authorised persons
note: Police signals for left-hand traffic: stop traffic from the front, from behind, from both; beckon traffic on from the front, behind or side.

title: The Highway Code (UK), Light signals controlling traffic
note: Traffic light meanings, green filter arrows and flashing amber in left-hand traffic.

title: The Highway Code (UK), Road markings
note: Centre lines, double lines (obey the line nearer to you), hatched areas, box junctions and lane arrows in left-hand traffic.
